result.title: MixReact: Physics-Based Reactive Humanoid Control from Multimodal Cues via a Discrete-Continuous Mixture of Transformers
result.summary: Humanoid agents in everyday environments are expected to react to diverse cues as humans do, with semantically appropriate and physically executable behaviors. Existing cue-driven reaction generation methods support only a narrow range of cue modalities and are limited to purely kinematic generation, leaving the resulting reactions susceptible to physical artifacts. To this end, we present MixReact, the first unified framework for physics-based reactive humanoid control from text, audio, and video cues, integrating a Discrete--Continuous Mixture of Transformers (DisCo-MoT) for state prediction with a History-aware Action Transformer (HAT) for physical execution. DisCo-MoT couples a discrete masked-modeling branch with a continuous autoregressive diffusion branch via one-way mixture attention within a MoT architecture. Guidance from discrete context mitigates collapse into averaged behaviors in one-to-many reaction generation, while direct prediction in continuous state space bypasses the decoding bottleneck of discrete representations. HAT then maps the predicted next state and observed execution history to executable actions, enabling robust closed-loop control in physics-based simulation. Experiments across all three modalities demonstrate consistent improvements over the baselines in fidelity, diversity, and physical consistency, while ablations validate the complementary contributions of the components. Our code will be released to facilitate future research. Project page: https://binlee26.github.io/MixReact_Page/

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MixReact，从文本、音频、视频线索出发，在物理仿真中生成可执行的人形反应行为：用离散掩码建模分支与连续自回归扩散分支经单向 mixture attention 组合的 DisCo-MoT 预测下一状态，再由历史感知的动作 Transformer 映射为动作实现闭环控制。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「离散语义上下文 + 连续状态空间直接预测」的混合设计，以及用离散引导抑制一对多生成中向平均行为坍缩的思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态表示与信息坍缩、视觉线索筛选之间的对应关系；但论文面向机器人控制，与 VLM 推理的迁移需自行判断。
